question: A scheme by the Government of India to maintain a viable population of tigers in India since 1973 is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project Tiger**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project Tiger was started in 1973 with 9 tiger reserves to conserve our national animal, the tiger**__.

 __
 
• Tiger sanctuaries have been set up on a core/buffer strategy. Core areas have the legal status of a national park or sanctuary, while buffer or peripheral areas are a mixture of forest and non-forest land, managed as multi-use areas.
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Environment, Forest, and Climate Change that provides central assistance to tiger states for tiger conservation in designated tiger reserves.
 
• The process of estimating the number of tigers in a given area is called 'Tiger Census'.
 
• Every 4 years the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) conducts a tiger census across India.
